notes: Opens «و سأله:» with the asker a pronoun and unnamed; prev1 (pronoun only) and prev2 (names the Imam Musa as the one asked) supply no named asker, so no chain can be read without guessing an extra link.
The Imam is named only in prev2 (علي بن جعفر asks أخاه موسى بن جعفر); it is not written in this text and is not taken.
